reviews.text: We live in North Austin and needed a landscaping company that would really maintain our yard, not just do a quick mow, blow, and go in 15 minutes. We reached out to Zazu Landscaping, and we couldn't be happier. Their team carefully tends to our yard, leaves everything spotless, and even bags and hauls away the leaves. Great service!
reviews.name: DORON YACOBY

reviews.text: Waw! What a game changer. My lawn has never looked better. Seamless interaction, great price and all with a huge smile. So glad I found ZaZu
reviews.name: Shai Tofach

reviews.text: That's it, I finally found a company I want to stick with! Great quality and very thorough team. Unlike with other companies that once they leave, you feel annoyed when you find here and there things they missed or forgot - here you feel that you finally get a proper value for the price.
reviews.name: Segev Mazovskiy

reviews.text: Izzy and the Zazu crew did such a great job maintaining our yard and making sure the weeds are at bay without us having to point out and explicitly ask.
reviews.name: Ori

reviews.text: I helped a friend get his yard under control. We found ZaZu Landscaping and so far the experience has been good. The quality is great. The manager is responsive. They even take care of the weeds. They're not cheap but the service is worth it.
reviews.name: Jonathan Elkayam

reviews.text: ZaZu Landscaping is a great company. Quality work, honest people and very communicative. Strongly recommend
reviews.name: Michal Shapira
